package rulefixtures

import (
	"context"
	"net/http"

	"github.com/gin-gonic/gin"
)

// scenario for gin_handler_stores_context_in_struct_field: Code that saves `*gin.Context` onto long-lived structs.
// fixture polarity: positive; family: architecture; severity: warning.

type RequestHandler struct {
	Ctx  *gin.Context
	ctx  context.Context
}

func (h *RequestHandler) Handle() {
	id := h.Ctx.Param("id")
	name := h.Ctx.Query("name")
	h.Ctx.JSON(http.StatusOK, gin.H{"id": id, "name": name})
}

func StoreContextHandler(c *gin.Context) {
	handler := &RequestHandler{
		Ctx: c,
		ctx: c.Request.Context(),
	}
	handler.Handle()
}
